visual.general_description: Six histology panels of the jejunal cancer: two H&E images and four mismatch repair immunostains.
visual.detailed_description: Six-panel composite of a 2 by 3 grid: two H&E images (a, b) in the top row and four immunostained images (c MLH1, d MSH2, e MSH6, f PMS2) in the next two rows. Each panel has its letter in a white box at the upper left; the immunostains carry the protein name in a white box at the lower right. The H&E panels show glandular tumor and a mucin-rich area. In all four immunostains the central tumor glands are blue-purple without brown nuclear staining while crypts and stromal cells at the upper left stain brown, and a black arrow near the top of panel a and of each stain points at a small gland edge or focus. No patient name, identifier, date or scale bar is visible.

panels.general_description: H&E-stained glandular tumor tissue with a black arrow at the top.
panels.detailed_description: Pink and purple H&E tissue filled with irregular, crowded glands lined by dark purple nuclei, with small round dark nuclei of inflammatory cells between the glands on the left and upper area and white gland lumina. A black arrow near the top centre points at a gland edge. The letter a is in a white box at the upper left. No scale bar, patient name, date or identifier is visible.
